gaps.text: Disc and digital releases for PlayStation 4/5 and Xbox One / Series X|S: no redump or No-Intro DAT for these platforms exists in libretro-database or on redump.org, so their regional releases, serials and versions are not listed.
Mobile releases: the stores publish only the current version; no source of the version history was reachable (Google Play and Apple pages give no history; PCGamingWiki answered 403).
PC patches of GTA IV (1.0.0.0 to 1.0.8.0, Complete Edition 1.2.0.x) and GTA V builds: the citable lists (PCGamingWiki, gtamods.com) could not be reached (403 / 503).

Digital PC releases (Steam, Rockstar Games Launcher, Epic, GOG and the old Rockstar Classics downloads): store build numbers carry no version names; only the executable builds Eyefinder identifies are listed.
Mac releases: no DAT of Mac discs or of the App Store versions was used.
Digital entries (PSN, Xbox Live) come from No-Intro and list licence or add-on files, not every regional storefront release.
